test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit between J and I. Only M sits to the right of K. Only one person sits between I and K. O sits at some place to the right of L but at some place to the left of N. How many people sit between N and L?
solution:
Given: Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) Only two people sit between J and I.

2) Only M sits to the right of K.

3) Only one person sits between I and K.

4) O sits at some place to the right of L but at some place to the left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10bab74f360ba45fef6f23cce2224bdd3bc099078a3af32b3773512f0d4d105f.png] 

So, 2 people sit between N and L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
